grid.boundary: Cells are half-open [west,east),[south,north); regional bbox includes edge points.
grid.domain: Initial Kalimantan study boxes only; new regions require projection review.

metrics.detections: Individual satellite observation rows, not wildfire incidents
metrics.occupied_cells: Distinct cells across the selected month or boundary-month interval
metrics.daily_cell_sum: Sum of distinct daily cells; a recurring cell contributes once each day
metrics.frp: Pixel-integrated fire radiative power in MW; not burned area

confidence.warning: Policies are not equivalent probabilities across instruments

harmonization.status: Common grid, separate sources and versions only
harmonization.calibration: Nonnegative linear candidate, held-out latest year; never automatically validated; spatial and temporal stability review required

baseline.reference: Previous complete same-calendar months, identical source, collection, region, metric and confidence policy
baseline.zero_baseline: Percentage is null; absolute difference remains available
baseline.coverage: Operator-declared file completeness, no rejected rows; cloud/overpass exposure not available

limitations: Five-day samples do not establish a full monthly total or historical baseline
Missing months are null, not zero
Imported complete days do not imply complete clear-sky observations
Grid occupancy does not estimate burned area
No forecasting; no validated sensor equivalence
All thermal anomaly types retained, including potential nonvegetation sources

metadata.attribution: NASA FIRMS MODIS Collection 6.1 / VIIRS standard-processing observations
warnings: Hotspot observations are not verified individual wildfire incidents.
No detection does not establish absence of fire; cloud and overpass coverage are not measured.
Import completeness describes supplied files, not clear-sky observation opportunity.
Raw sensor counts and native confidence filters are not scientifically equivalent.
